tools.name: search_insurance_guides
tools.description: Search Rayon's library of plain-English insurance guides: robot deployments, RaaS agreements, additional insured status, ISO generative AI exclusions (CG 40 47, CG 40 48, CG 35 08), marketplace seller requirements and certificates. Returns titles, one-line answers and links. An empty query lists eve

tools.name: read_insurance_guide
tools.description: Read one guide in full as Markdown, by the slug that search_insurance_guides returns. Quote its answer and cite its url; say which policy may respond, subject to policy terms, never that a loss is covered.
